bugs.title: Committed user-created Text object cannot be re-selected by clicking
steps: Commit text with Ctrl+Enter or click outside.
Click on empty canvas area to deselect.
Click directly on the "basic" text object.
bugs.expected: The text object becomes selected, displaying the selection bounding box and inspector properties.
bugs.actual: Object remains unselected. Click hit-tested element <DIV id="pdf-form-layer"> with computed pointer-events: "auto" and parent pointer-events: "auto".
bugs.rootCause: In EditorViewport.astro, #editor-overlay-layer has class "pointer-events-none". In pdf-editor.astro line 1649, object container el is assigned "cursor-pointer" but does not set "pointer-events: auto". Consequently, clicks pass through the overlay object to underlying textLayer or canvas unless explicitly selected or pointer-events: auto is applied to child elements.
bugs.suggestedFixDirection: Add "pointer-events-auto" class to child object elements in renderOverlayObjects() or set el.style.pointerEvents = "auto" on overlay items.

bugs.title: Text Tool remains active after canceling inline text input instead of reverting to Select mode
steps: Click canvas to open inline text editor.
Press Escape or click away without typing to cancel.
Click an existing object on canvas.
bugs.expected: Active tool resets to 'select', allowing subsequent clicks to select and move objects.
bugs.actual: Active tool remains in text creation mode, causing subsequent clicks on canvas to open new empty text inputs.
bugs.rootCause: cleanupInlineEditor() in editorInteractionController.ts does not reset activeTool to 'select' when canceled via Escape or blur.
bugs.suggestedFixDirection: In cleanupInlineEditor() or cancel handler, call editorStore.setActiveTool('select') when destroyed without committing.

bugs.title: Edited PDF text font changes to Inter/Helvetica and does not match original document typography
steps: Load a PDF containing text with a custom, serif, or distinct font.
Click on an existing text item to display the text action bar.
Click "Edit" to replace text and type modifications.
Inspect the DOM element and exported PDF.
bugs.expected: Replacement text retains the original PDF font family, weight, and visual appearance.
bugs.actual: Replacement text is forced to "Inter" in the overlay DOM and exported as standard Helvetica in pdfExportEngine.ts.
bugs.rootCause: 1) In pdfTextLayer.ts, fontFamily is derived from computedStyle.fontFamily (which defaults to Inter) rather than parsing textContent.styles[item.fontName]. 2) In editorInteractionController.ts line 1102, fontFamily is hardcoded to "Inter". 3) In pdfExportEngine.ts lines 135-142, any font not matching "times" or "courier" defaults to fontHelvetica.
bugs.suggestedFixDirection: Extract fontName and font attributes from PDF.js textContent.styles; pass original font attributes to TextReplacementEditorObject; match nearest available font or preserve styling in pdfExportEngine.ts.

bugs.title: Form Overlay Layer acts as full-viewport click shield, blocking interactions with underlying Text Layer and Overlay Objects
steps: Load any PDF document containing selectable text.
Click directly on rendered text in the document to select it or reveal the action bar.
bugs.expected: Click hits the text span in #pdf-text-layer, selecting the existing text and displaying the floating action bar.
bugs.actual: Click is absorbed by #pdf-form-layer (<DIV id="pdf-form-layer"> with pointer-events: auto and z-index: 10), which covers the entire page and swallows pointer events.
bugs.rootCause: In EditorViewport.astro, #pdf-form-layer has class 'absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-auto z-10'. Because pointer-events is enabled on the entire container div spanning 100% of the canvas, clicks anywhere on empty or non-widget canvas space hit this transparent layer and never reach #pdf-text-layer or #editor-overlay-layer.
bugs.suggestedFixDirection: Change #pdf-form-layer class to 'pointer-events-none' and apply 'pointer-events-auto' strictly to individual form widget DOM elements (.form-field-widget).
